paper_title: Dark Matter from Axion Strings with Adaptive Mesh Refinement
notes: This is a numerical/cosmological study using adaptive-mesh-refinement simulations of the axion string network in the post-inflationary scenario. Its headline result is a prediction of the QCD axion MASS, m_a in the range (40,180) microeV (f_a in (3.1e10, 1.4e11) GeV), from computing the string-induced dark matter abundance (Eq. 2). It does NOT report any measured or observational exclusion limit on an axion/dark-photon coupling, nor is it a sensitivity projection for a specific experiment. There is no coupling curve to extract; it merely motivates future searches (ADMX, MADMAX, plasma haloscopes) in this mass window. Hence is_new_limit=false. coupling_type set to null (coupling_convention field is a placeholder, no coupling reported).
